headline: Growth stalls q/q as revenue and profit both retreat
summary_short: MarketAxess's Q2 FY2026 revenue was $218.4M, down 6.4% q/q and roughly flat y/y (-0.5%); diluted EPS of $1.93 fell 12.3% q/q but rose 1.0% y/y as net income declined 12.6% q/q to $68.1M.
summary_long: Revenue was $218.4M, down 6.4% q/q and 0.5% y/y. Net margin fell to 31.2% from 33.4% in Q1 (-219bp) and from 32.4% a year ago (-126bp). Diluted EPS was $1.93, down 12.3% q/q but up 1.0% y/y as diluted share count fell 5.5% y/y. Net income was $68.1M, down 12.6% q/q and 4.3% y/y. Cash and equivalents fell to $245.8M, down 34.9% q/q and 46.9% y/y.
